Callout.Name: Assault in Progress
Callout.Message: Assault in progress in the street, caller watching from a window.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect attacking another, both on foot.

Script.Line: He put his hands on me first. That is why it happened.
Nobody called you. This is between us.
I am done. Look at me, I am done.

Lines.Approach: One suspect on another in the street, and the caller will not come out.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
